meta.note: Curated prototype risk library for data center development and operations. Base scores and trigger rules reflect the author's judgment informed by public industry sources, not proprietary company data. Likelihood and impact are scored 1 to 5; score = likelihood x impact.

impact.5: Severe: >15% cost, >6 mo, or COD/lease default

risks.title: Land control, title, or easement defect
risks.description: Site not fully controlled, or title/easement issues (utility corridors, access, mineral rights) surface after commitment.

triggers.note: Option only; exercise conditions and timing exposed

mitigations: Complete ALTA survey and title commitment with easement mapping before hard money goes in
Negotiate option terms with extension rights tied to interconnection milestones
Secure access and utility easements as closing conditions
risks.kri: Days to option expiry vs. days to interconnection study completion

risks.title: Adverse geotechnical or subsurface conditions
risks.description: Poor bearing capacity, shallow rock, high groundwater, or karst drives foundation redesign and cost.

triggers.note: Large footprint increases exposure to variable conditions

mitigations: Phase geotechnical program: preliminary borings before LOI, full program before GMP
Carry geotechnical contingency separately in the budget until borings close out
Include differing site conditions clause with clear baseline report in the GC contract
risks.kri: Percent of building footprint covered by borings at GMP

risks.title: Environmental contamination requiring remediation
risks.description: Phase I/II ESA identifies recognized environmental conditions; remediation adds cost, schedule, and lender conditions.

triggers.note: Can still walk away before commitment

mitigations: Phase I ESA as a diligence gate; Phase II on any REC before closing
Seller environmental indemnity or escrow for known conditions
Pollution legal liability policy at closing
risks.kri: Open RECs without a closed Phase II

risks.title: Flood exposure
risks.description: Site or critical equipment in a mapped or unmapped flood path; stormwater design inadequate for extreme events.
mitigations: Site critical equipment above 500-year elevation, not just 100-year
Independent hydrology study covering upstream development
Verify flood sublimits in builder's risk and property programs
risks.kri: Lowest critical equipment elevation vs. 500-year flood elevation

risks.title: Hurricane and severe wind
risks.description: Wind damage to structures, roof-mounted equipment, and utility supply during construction and operations.
mitigations: Design to enhanced wind speed above code minimum for mission-critical
Hurricane season construction sequencing and tie-down plan
Named-storm deductible and sublimit review in insurance placement
risks.kri: Named-storm deductible as percent of TIV

risks.title: Tornado and hail
risks.description: Convective storms damage exposed cooling equipment, roofing, and temporary construction works.
mitigations: Hail-rated coils and guards on rooftop and yard equipment
Storm shelter and severe weather procedures for site workforce
Hail sublimit check in property program
risks.kri: Unprotected exposed equipment count

risks.title: Wildfire and smoke
risks.description: Wildfire threatens transmission lines and site; smoke degrades air-side cooling and filtration.

triggers.note: High wildfire exposure; PSPS events likely

mitigations: Defensible space and non-combustible perimeter
Filtration upgrade and smoke-mode procedures for economizer systems
Dual transmission paths where wildfire threatens single corridor
risks.kri: Public safety power shutoff events affecting feeder per year

risks.title: Seismic event
risks.description: Earthquake damages structure, raised floor, and rack anchoring; utility restoration delayed.
mitigations: Importance factor and equipment anchorage above code minimum
Seismic bracing verified during commissioning
Earthquake sublimit and deductible review
risks.kri: Percent of critical equipment with verified anchorage

risks.title: Water availability for cooling
risks.description: Water rights, municipal allocation, or drought restrictions constrain evaporative cooling capacity.

triggers.note: Groundwater rights and aquifer decline exposure

mitigations: Water supply agreement with defined allocation before design freeze
Design for dry-mode fallback at reduced capacity
Reclaimed water source where available
risks.kri: Contracted water allocation vs. peak design demand

risks.title: Community opposition and reputational risk
risks.description: Local opposition over power, water, noise, or tax incentives delays approvals or forces concessions.

triggers.note: Water scarcity is a public issue in region

mitigations: Community benefits agreement and early stakeholder engagement plan
Noise modeling and generator testing schedule disclosed upfront
Single accountable spokesperson and media protocol
risks.kri: Public comments opposed vs. supportive at last hearing

risks.title: Wetlands, species, and federal environmental review
risks.description: Wetland delineation, endangered species, or federal nexus triggers 404 permitting or NEPA review.

triggers.note: No delineation or agency consultation yet

mitigations: Wetland delineation and habitat survey before site commitment
Site plan to avoid jurisdictional features rather than mitigate
Early agency pre-application meetings
risks.kri: Acres of jurisdictional impact in current site plan

risks.title: Fiber and network connectivity
risks.description: Insufficient diverse fiber routes or carrier presence delays tenant readiness.
mitigations: Two physically diverse fiber entries with separate carriers
Carrier build agreements executed with COD-aligned milestones
Meet-me room design reviewed with tenant
risks.kri: Number of diverse fiber paths under contract

risks.title: Zoning and entitlement denial or onerous conditions
risks.description: Rezoning, special use, or site plan approval is denied, delayed, or conditioned in ways that impair the project.
mitigations: By-right site selection where possible; avoid discretionary approvals
Land use counsel engaged before LOI
Condition option exercise on entitlement approval
risks.kri: Discretionary approvals remaining on critical path

risks.title: Air permit for backup or onsite generation
risks.description: Emissions permitting for diesel gensets or gas generation (minor source vs. Title V) delays energization or limits run hours.

triggers.note: Prime power generation raises permit class and scrutiny
Generator fleet likely exceeds minor source thresholds

mitigations: Air permit application submitted before genset procurement
Tier 4 or SCR equipment selection to stay below thresholds
Run-hour limits reflected in operating procedures
risks.kri: Air permit issuance date vs. genset delivery date

risks.title: Utility and regulatory approval of large-load interconnection
risks.description: PUC, ISO, or utility large-load process (studies, tariffs, deposits) adds time and conditions beyond the utility agreement.
mitigations: Track regulatory dockets affecting large-load tariffs monthly
Regulatory counsel review of utility agreement conditions
Deposit and study fees carried as at-risk capital
risks.kri: Open regulatory conditions precedent in utility agreement

risks.title: Tax incentive not executed or subject to clawback
risks.description: Sales tax exemption, abatement, or PILOT not finalized, or clawback triggered by job or capex shortfall.

triggers.note: Incentive assumed in pro forma but not executed
Legislative review of DC incentives active

mitigations: Pro forma sensitivity without incentive
Clawback thresholds tracked against actual jobs and capex
Executed agreement as condition to GMP
risks.kri: Incentive value assumed vs. executed

risks.title: Building code and fire marshal approvals for new technology
risks.description: Liquid cooling, lithium-ion ESS, or high-density electrical rooms face code interpretation delays.

triggers.note: Limited AHJ precedent for liquid cooling

mitigations: Pre-application meeting with AHJ on novel systems
Third-party code consultant and alternative means submittals
NFPA 855 compliance plan for any ESS
risks.kri: Open code interpretation requests

risks.title: Regulatory or policy change
risks.description: New state or local rules (moratoria, water reporting, rate design, large-load tariffs) change project economics after commitment.

triggers.note: Active legislative attention to data centers

mitigations: Legislative tracking and industry association participation
Grandfathering language in utility and incentive agreements
Scenario analysis on rate design changes
risks.kri: Pending bills affecting data centers in state session

risks.title: Power not secured or interconnection delayed
risks.description: Utility cannot deliver contracted capacity by required date; interconnection studies or transmission build slip.

triggers.note: Campus scale typically requires transmission upgrades
Constrained transmission market; queue delays common

mitigations: Executed electric service agreement with firm energization date before GMP
Phased energization aligned with tenant ramp
Bridge power options (onsite generation, BESS) evaluated as contingency
risks.kri: Utility energization date vs. tenant COD, in months

risks.title: Network upgrade cost allocation
risks.description: Utility assigns transmission or substation upgrade costs to the project beyond what was underwritten.

triggers.note: Gigawatt-scale upgrades are material to budget
Upgrades more likely to be assigned to project

mitigations: Cap or share upgrade costs in the electric service agreement
Refund mechanisms for shared infrastructure
Upgrade scope confirmed in facilities study before financing close
risks.kri: Upgrade cost estimate vs. underwriting

risks.title: Energization slips against COD
risks.description: Even with an agreement, utility construction, equipment, or testing slips push energization past tenant delivery.
mitigations: Monthly utility construction schedule review with named milestones
Owner-furnished substation equipment to de-risk utility procurement
Temporary or bridge power plan sized for commissioning loads
risks.kri: Utility milestone slip in weeks, rolling 90 days

risks.title: Onsite generation execution
risks.description: Gas supply, turbine or reciprocating engine lead times, emissions, and O&M complexity for behind-the-meter generation.

triggers.note: Turbine and engine lead times exceed 24 months

mitigations: Firm gas transportation agreement with pipeline capacity confirmed
Turbine slot reservation before financing close
Experienced O&M provider under long-term service agreement
risks.kri: Generation equipment delivery date vs. energization need

risks.title: Curtailment and demand response obligations
risks.description: Grid operator requires large loads to curtail during emergencies; tenant SLA and revenue exposed.

triggers.note: No backup capacity to ride through curtailment

mitigations: Curtailment terms mirrored in tenant lease
Backup generation or BESS sized for expected curtailment events
Participation in demand response programs for revenue offset
risks.kri: Curtailment hours per year, contracted vs. actual

risks.title: Long-lead electrical equipment delay
risks.description: Transformers, MV switchgear, and generators with 18 to 36 month lead times arrive late or slots are lost.
mitigations: Early procurement approval tracked as a KRI: PO placement date vs. need date, with finance sign-off before GMP
OEM slot reservations and framework agreements rather than reliance on vendor diversification
Refurbished and secondary-market transformer vendor pool pre-qualified as contingency
Weekly expediting reports with factory milestones
risks.kri: Weeks between PO placement and latest date that still meets need-on-site

risks.title: Backup generator and UPS availability
risks.description: Genset and UPS allocations consumed by competing hyperscale demand; substitutions change design.

triggers.note: Large fleet order competes for allocation

mitigations: Allocation agreements with OEM for annual volume
Design flexibility for alternate genset sizes
Owner-furnished procurement outside GC contract
risks.kri: Genset allocation confirmed vs. design count

risks.title: Cooling equipment lead time and integration
risks.description: Chillers, dry coolers, CDUs, and liquid cooling components delayed or fail integration with IT vendor requirements.

triggers.note: Immature supply chain for direct liquid cooling
High density ties cooling to specific GPU platform

mitigations: Tenant IT platform locked before cooling design freeze
Factory witness tests for CDUs and manifolds
Spare CDU capacity in design
risks.kri: Cooling design freeze date vs. GPU platform confirmation

risks.title: Tariffs and trade policy
risks.description: Import tariffs on transformers, switchgear, steel, and copper raise cost or force sourcing changes mid-procurement.
mitigations: Tariff pass-through language capped in supply contracts
Domestic or tariff-exempt sourcing alternatives identified
Commodity escalation contingency line
risks.kri: Percent of equipment value with fixed pricing

risks.title: Vendor concentration and financial health
risks.description: Single-source suppliers or financially weak vendors create delivery and warranty exposure.
mitigations: Financial review of critical vendors before award
Dual-source strategy for transformers and switchgear
Escrow or step-in rights for proprietary systems
risks.kri: Share of critical equipment from single vendor

risks.title: Equipment quality and factory acceptance failures
risks.description: FAT failures or shipping damage delay installation and commissioning.
mitigations: Witnessed FAT for all major electrical and mechanical equipment
Third-party inspection at factory and on receipt
Marine cargo and transit coverage confirmed
risks.kri: FAT first-pass rate

risks.title: Logistics, transport permits, and laydown
risks.description: Oversized transformer transport, crane availability, port congestion, and site storage constraints.
mitigations: Transport route survey and permits before shipment
Laydown and storage plan with climate control for sensitive equipment
Crane and rigging booked against delivery schedule
risks.kri: Shipments without confirmed transport permit

risks.title: Owner-furnished IT and GPU delivery
risks.description: Where the operator furnishes compute, GPU allocation and delivery timing drive revenue start.
mitigations: GPU allocation agreements with delivery windows
Shell readiness decoupled from IT delivery in schedule
Lease structure clarifying who furnishes compute
risks.kri: GPU delivery date vs. facility ready-for-IT date

risks.title: General contractor capability and capacity
risks.description: GC lacks mission-critical experience or is overextended across competing data center projects.

triggers.note: GC without data center track record

mitigations: Prequalification on data center references and current backlog
Key personnel clause naming superintendent and electrical lead
Monthly capacity review of GC portfolio
risks.kri: GC concurrent data center projects vs. stated capacity

risks.title: Contract structure and risk allocation
risks.description: Contract form misallocates cost, schedule, and change risk; liquidated damages inadequate relative to tenant exposure.

triggers.note: Claims and change order friction more likely

mitigations: Back-to-back liquidated damages with tenant lease
Clear change order thresholds and approval matrix
Contingency ownership and shared savings terms defined
risks.kri: GC LD cap vs. tenant delay exposure

risks.title: Skilled labor shortage
risks.description: Electricians and mechanical trades unavailable at required volume; productivity and overtime costs rise.

triggers.note: Peak electrical headcount in the hundreds

mitigations: Labor availability study at site selection
Prefabrication and modular electrical rooms
Per diem and travel packages budgeted upfront
risks.kri: Electrical headcount on site vs. plan

risks.title: Health and safety incident
risks.description: Serious injury or fatality from energized work, falls, heat, or rigging halts work and triggers OSHA action.
mitigations: Energized work permit and lockout procedures audited weekly
Heat illness prevention plan
Leading indicators (near misses, observations) reported monthly
risks.kri: TRIR and near-miss reports per 200,000 hours

risks.title: Quality defects and commissioning failures
risks.description: Installation defects surface during Level 3 to 5 commissioning, driving rework and delay.
mitigations: Independent commissioning agent from design phase
Integrated systems test scripts approved before Level 4
First-of-kind mockups for repetitive electrical rooms
risks.kri: Open commissioning issues by severity

risks.title: Late design changes
risks.description: Tenant platform or density changes after design freeze force rework of electrical and cooling.
mitigations: Design freeze gate with tenant sign-off
Flexible design envelope for density range
Change impact assessment required before approval
risks.kri: Design changes after freeze, count and value

risks.title: Contractor default or insolvency
risks.description: GC or key subcontractor fails financially or abandons work.
mitigations: Payment and performance bonds or subcontractor default insurance
Financial statements reviewed annually
Step-in rights and assignment of subcontracts
risks.kri: GC backlog to working capital ratio

risks.title: Change orders and claims disputes
risks.description: Volume of change orders and unresolved claims escalates to formal dispute.
mitigations: Change order log reviewed weekly with aging
Dispute resolution ladder and standing neutral
Documentation standards enforced from notice to proceed
risks.kri: Unresolved change orders over 30 days

risks.title: Design density obsolescence
risks.description: Rack power density and cooling requirements demanded by tenants at COD exceed the design basis set at design freeze, making the facility less leasable or requiring retrofit.

triggers.note: GPU generations reset density targets every 12 to 18 months
Air-cooled design has hard density ceiling
Long horizon between design freeze and delivery

mitigations: Design to a density range with liquid-ready piping stubs and electrical headroom
Density review gate at each 6-month interval before design freeze
Lease term allowing tenant-funded retrofit for density above design basis
risks.kri: Design density (kW/rack) vs. current market requirement for target workload

risks.title: Critical path slip against COD
risks.description: Cumulative slip across power, equipment, and commissioning threatens committed delivery.
mitigations: Integrated master schedule with utility and OEM milestones
Monthly schedule risk analysis on critical path
Recovery plan triggers defined by float thresholds
risks.kri: Total float on critical path, in weeks

risks.title: Tenant delivery liquidated damages
risks.description: Missed delivery date triggers lease LDs, rent abatement, or termination rights.
mitigations: Grace period and force majeure terms negotiated in lease
Delay LDs flowed down to GC and OEMs
Delay-in-startup coverage under builder's risk
risks.kri: Lease LD exposure per week of delay

risks.title: Weather and seasonal productivity loss
risks.description: Hurricane season, extreme heat, or winter conditions reduce productivity and cause stoppages.
mitigations: Weather days built into baseline schedule by month
Enclosure and conditioning sequenced before winter or summer peaks
Weather-related delay terms clarified in contract
risks.kri: Weather days used vs. allowance

risks.title: Commissioning compression
risks.description: Schedule pressure shortens Level 4 and 5 commissioning, leaving latent defects into operations.
mitigations: Commissioning duration protected as a non-negotiable in schedule
Integrated systems test as tenant acceptance milestone
Cx agent reports directly to owner, not GC
risks.kri: Planned vs. actual Level 5 duration

risks.title: Cost escalation and budget overrun
risks.description: Material, equipment, and labor escalation exceed budget assumptions.
mitigations: Escalation index tracked monthly against budget assumptions
Early procurement to lock major equipment pricing
Value engineering log maintained through design
risks.kri: Forecast at completion vs. budget, percent variance

risks.title: Inadequate contingency
risks.description: Contingency consumed early by design or site issues, leaving no reserve for construction surprises.

triggers.note: Most contingency draws occur in construction

mitigations: Contingency drawdown curve compared to earned value monthly
Separate owner, design, and construction contingencies
Contingency release approval matrix
risks.kri: Contingency remaining vs. percent complete

risks.title: Early-stage estimate accuracy
risks.description: Class 4 or 5 estimates carry 30 percent or wider ranges; commitments made on them prove optimistic.
mitigations: Estimate class and accuracy range stated on every budget
Benchmark against recent comparable projects per MW
Board approvals staged to estimate maturity
risks.kri: Estimate class at last approval

risks.title: Financing not closed or capital unavailable
risks.description: Debt or equity fails to close on required timeline, or conditions precedent cannot be satisfied.
mitigations: Term sheet before major procurement commitments
Conditions precedent tracker owned by finance
Equity bridge capacity confirmed for delays
risks.kri: Open conditions precedent vs. required close date

risks.title: Interest rate exposure
risks.description: Floating rate construction debt exposed to rate increases over the build period.

triggers.note: Large loan balance amplifies rate sensitivity

mitigations: Interest rate cap or swap on a defined share of notional
Sensitivity analysis at plus 200 basis points
Hedge policy approved at investment committee
risks.kri: Unhedged floating exposure as percent of debt

risks.title: Tenant credit and lease-up
risks.description: No signed tenant, weak counterparty credit, or lease terms below underwriting.
mitigations: Credit review and parent guarantee for non-investment-grade tenants
Phased construction gated on lease execution
Security deposit or letter of credit sized to re-tenanting cost
risks.kri: Contracted MW vs. built MW

risks.title: Power price exposure and hedging
risks.description: Energy cost exposed to market volatility where lease passes through power at cost or operator bears energy risk.
mitigations: Power pass-through in lease with defined mechanism
Fixed-price PPA or block hedge for owner-borne load
Hedge policy defining tenor and coverage ratio
risks.kri: Percent of load with fixed price or pass-through

risks.title: Currency exposure on imported equipment
risks.description: Equipment contracts denominated in foreign currency move against budget between award and payment.
mitigations: USD-denominated contracts where possible
FX forwards for material foreign-currency commitments
FX exposure reported in monthly cost report
risks.kri: Unhedged foreign-currency commitments in USD

risks.title: Market absorption and valuation
risks.description: Softening demand, cap rate expansion, or new supply erodes exit value and refinancing capacity.
mitigations: Market supply pipeline tracked quarterly
Underwriting sensitivity on cap rate and rent
Lease term aligned with debt maturity
risks.kri: Pipeline MW under construction in market vs. absorption

risks.title: Liquidity and draw timing
risks.description: Lender draw conditions, retainage, and payment timing strain project cash flow.
mitigations: Monthly cash flow forecast reconciled to draw schedule
Lender inspector aligned with pay application cycle
Working capital reserve for draw delays
risks.kri: Days from pay application to funding

risks.title: Utility outage and grid instability
risks.description: Grid events (winter storms, heat waves, transmission faults) interrupt supply beyond backup design.
mitigations: Dual utility feeds from separate substations where feasible
Generator runtime and fuel contracts sized for 72-hour events
Monthly load bank and transfer testing
risks.kri: Utility events per year and longest duration

risks.title: Cooling failure or thermal event
risks.description: Loss of cooling at high density causes rapid thermal excursion and IT shutdown.

triggers.note: Minutes of thermal ride-through at high density

mitigations: Thermal ride-through analysis and chilled water storage
Leak detection and automatic isolation on liquid loops
Concurrent maintainability verified in commissioning
risks.kri: Thermal ride-through time at design load

risks.title: Single points of failure in topology
risks.description: Redundancy level or design leaves single points of failure in power or cooling distribution.
mitigations: Failure mode and effects analysis on one-line and P&IDs
Tenant SLA aligned to actual topology
Concurrent maintainability procedures documented
risks.kri: Open single points of failure from FMEA

risks.title: Fuel supply during extended outage
risks.description: Diesel or gas supply cannot sustain generation through multi-day regional events.

triggers.note: Regional fuel logistics disrupted in storms
Gas supply curtailment in winter events

mitigations: Onsite storage for 48 to 72 hours at full load
Priority fuel delivery contracts with two suppliers
Fuel quality testing and polishing program
risks.kri: Hours of onsite fuel at full load

risks.title: Operations staffing and procedures
risks.description: Insufficient trained staff, or incomplete MOPs, SOPs, and EOPs at handover.

triggers.note: New skills required for liquid systems

mitigations: Operations team onboarded during Level 4 commissioning
Procedure library complete before tenant acceptance
Human error tracked as a leading indicator
risks.kri: Procedures complete vs. required at handover

risks.title: Business continuity and disaster recovery gaps
risks.description: BC/DR plan absent, outdated, or untested; recovery time and communications undefined.
mitigations: BC/DR plan covering utility loss, fire, cyber, and regional events
Annual tabletop and one live exercise
Crisis communication tree with tenant contacts
risks.kri: Months since last BC/DR exercise

risks.title: SLA breach and uptime penalties
risks.description: Availability shortfall triggers service credits, termination rights, or reputational damage.
mitigations: SLA terms matched to designed availability
Incident management and root cause process
Availability tracked monthly against SLA thresholds
risks.kri: Availability year to date vs. SLA

risks.title: Physical security breach
risks.description: Unauthorized access, theft, or sabotage compromises tenant environment.
mitigations: Layered perimeter, mantrap, and biometric access
Security operations center with 24/7 monitoring
Construction-phase site security and equipment theft controls
risks.kri: Access control exceptions per month

risks.title: Water supply interruption
risks.description: Municipal or well supply interrupted, forcing reduced cooling capacity.
mitigations: Onsite water storage for 24 to 48 hours
Dry-mode operating procedure at reduced load
Secondary supply agreement or trucking contract
risks.kri: Hours of onsite water storage at design load

risks.title: SOC 2 or ISO 27001 readiness gap
risks.description: Tenant or lender requires attestation the facility cannot deliver by go-live.
mitigations: Readiness assessment 12 months before go-live
Control owners assigned across facilities, security, and IT
Audit period and report type agreed with tenant
risks.kri: Open control gaps vs. audit start date

risks.title: OT and building system cybersecurity
risks.description: BMS, DCIM, and electrical controls exposed to cyber intrusion affecting availability.

triggers.note: No control framework applied to OT

mitigations: OT network segmentation and NIST CSF-aligned controls
Vendor remote access governed and logged
OT asset inventory and patch program
risks.kri: OT assets with known unpatched critical vulnerabilities

risks.title: Environmental compliance violation
risks.description: SWPPP, SPCC, air permit run-hour, or noise conditions violated during construction or operations.
mitigations: Permit condition register with named owners
Monthly compliance inspection and reporting
Generator run-hour tracking automated
risks.kri: Open notices of violation

risks.title: Audit and contract compliance findings
risks.description: Internal, lender, or tenant audits identify gaps in documentation, vendor SOC reports, or contract obligations.
mitigations: Obligations register from lease, loan, and utility agreements
Vendor SOC report collection annually
Audit findings tracked to closure
risks.kri: Audit findings open over 90 days

risks.title: Builder's risk coverage gaps
risks.description: Builder's risk limits, natural catastrophe sublimits, testing coverage, or delay-in-startup inadequate for exposure.
mitigations: Placement 90 days before notice to proceed
Hot testing and commissioning coverage confirmed
Delay-in-startup sized to lease LD exposure
risks.kri: Nat cat sublimit vs. probable maximum loss

risks.title: Property and business interruption at operations
risks.description: Operational property program capacity, valuation, and BI period insufficient for high total insured value.
mitigations: Transition from builder's risk to property program planned 6 months out
Statement of values updated at each phase
Contingent BI for utility service interruption
risks.kri: Insured value vs. replacement cost estimate

risks.title: Contractor insurance and wrap-up structure
risks.description: OCIP or CCIP structure, subcontractor compliance, and additional insured status leave gaps.
mitigations: Wrap-up decision made before GC award
Certificate tracking for all tiers
Contractual indemnity aligned to insurance
risks.kri: Subcontractors non-compliant with insurance requirements

risks.title: Claims management and recovery
risks.description: Poor documentation or late notice reduces recovery on property, delay, or liability claims.
mitigations: Incident reporting protocol with notice timelines
Cost tracking codes for claim-related spend
Claims advocate engaged with broker
risks.kri: Days from incident to carrier notice

risks.title: Cyber insurance availability and exclusions
risks.description: Cyber coverage limited or excludes OT and infrastructure events; tenant may require specific limits.
mitigations: Cyber controls documented for underwriting
OT and infrastructure exclusions negotiated
Limits aligned to tenant contract requirements
risks.kri: Cyber limit vs. tenant contractual requirement
